newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Govt troops move to Tajik rebel colonel's base.
newsitem.headline: Govt troops move to Tajik rebel colonel's base.

text.p: Some government armour moved on Friday into the southern Tajik town of Kurgan Tyube, stronghold of rebel colonel Makhmud Khudoyberdyev, local residents said.

Contacted by telephone, they said Khudoyberdyev, his family and guards had fled his house in the town and moved into the barracks of his elite brigade on the outskirts of Kurgan Tyube. The residents also said they had seen at least three government tanks near the town's only bus station.
The residents said armed looters had robbed Khodoyberdyev's house immediately after he had left it. They did not hear any fighting.

Khudoyberdyev moved his armour towards Dushanbe over the weekend in the wake of fighting between two rival warlords in the capital. But he appeared to suffer some military defeats and President Imomali Rakhmonov issued a decree sacking the colonel on Wednesday.

On Thursday, Khodoyberdyev refused to obey the order and said he was ready to resume fighting because the government had failed to withdraw its troops from around Kurgan Tyube, as agreed on Wednesday, he said.
